details:
I got tired of getting tagged in game maps like from 5 seconds away. And tired of people talking shit to me because Im lagging like it has anything to do with me. I really like socializing while playing games. Its more fun and you get to see more creativity while making friends. For example, I've found somebody with a Genshin Impact character. I also had one in favorite and I also became one. We decided to stick together and had a bit of fun but because I had so much lag I couldnt have fun much. I kept getting tagged in Zombie tag because of it like even when I ran away already like 10 seconds ago. I have a good internet too its just because of VRChat servers I have minimum 200 ping on my home room.
We even made discord servers to have fun together but me and many other EU or middle east players cant enjoy it anymore due to lag. And on top of that, In puzzle or horror games the items Im supposed hold get glitched or lagged behind me due to lag too which corrupts the game, creating synchronization problems if it goes missing in some of the maps. 
Im not saying that we should get limited servers we should still be able to play on US or EU whenever we want to. Like how we create instances. I should be able to decide if I want to play on EU servers while playing games so I dont lag or US for pubs etc.
title: EU Servers we can decide to play on while creating Instances
